M: nonnegative integer number of selected directed equations
endpoint_indices: each in {0,...,N-1}; loops and parallel edges allowed; validity implies M=0 when N=0
p: supplied promised prime; untrusted primality requires separately charged P_prime
matrix_entries: canonical F_p residues 0 through p-1; four per selected matrix
witness_output: nonzero projective coordinate pairs in one common F_(p^2), or F_p following base-field acceptance; normalized vertex outputs incur separate surcharge
optional_eta: odd p only; Euler certificate verified; invalid eta is auxiliary-input error, not UNSAT
field_setup: fixed input/setup/storage/output costs included for N=M=0
target_extraction: remains separate same-model S_B^bit and E_B^bit, never scalar costs substituted as bit costs
